_comment: Constructed from the published getWhInventory contract (v4/stock/getWhInventory), not captured from BCPL: no test credentials have been issued yet (open item 5). Every field name comes from the specification; the values exercise the variance the Flex types exist for - quantities as numbers and as quoted strings, a non-sellable bucket, a row with no SKU, and a row whose committed quantity exceeds what is held.
